en: Good acts beget a state of happiness, and sinful deeds bring on woe. One always reaps the fruit of one's acts. One never enjoys of suffers happiness or misery that is not the outcome of one's own acts.

sa: लब्धस्य त्यागमित्याहुन भोगं न च संचयम्। तस्य किं संचयेनार्थः कार्ये ज्यायसि तिष्ठति॥
en: One should make gift of what he has acquired, and not waste or spend it in gratifying his desire of enjoyment. What use is there in hoarding up wealth when proper objects exist in which to spend it.

sa: रथाश्वनागहीनास्तु पादातास्तव मारिष। पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्त्रा युद्धायैव व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Then deprived of cars, cavalry and clephants, twenty-five thousand warriors of your army addressed themselves for fighting on foot.

sa: अत्र ते राजशार्दूल वर्तयिष्ये कथामिमाम्। यद् वृत्तं पूर्वराजर्षेर्हयग्रीवस्य पाण्डव॥ शत्रू न हत्वा हतस्याजौ शूरस्याक्लिश्कर्मणः। असहायस्य संग्रामे निर्जितस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I shall recite to you, O foremost of kings, the story of what happened to an ancient king of the name of Hayagriva, O son of Pandu,the story of the heroic Hayagriva of unsullied deeds, who after having killed a host of enemies in battle, was himself defeated and killed while without a follower by his side.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽपि नृपतिर्हतसर्वस्वबान्धवः। ययौ शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तयन् विमना बहु॥
en: Deprived of everything and his heart heavily laden with sorrow and afflicted by painful thoughts king Duryodhana went away.

sa: गन्धवर्णरसस्पर्शा निवर्तन्ते स्वभावतः। तथैव सुखदुःखानि विधानमनुवर्तते॥
en: As smell, colour, taste, and touch originate of themselves, so happiness and misery originate from what has been preordained.

sa: व्यसनानि च सर्वाणि त्यजेथा भूरिदक्षिण। न चैव न प्रयुञ्जीत सङ्गं तु परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: O noble king, you should renounce all those evil practices which are called Vyasanas. It is not incumbent that you should never indulge in them. What, however, is necessary is that you should not be attached to them.

sa: भूतसंघानुचरितं रक्षोगणनिषेवितम्। पश्यन्तस्ते कुरुक्षेत्रं ययुराशु महारथाः।॥
en: The powerful car-warriors quickly proceeded, seeing the field of battle haunted by crowds of spirits and thronged with Rakshasas,

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् वैश्रवणो राजानं सपुरोहितम्। नाहं राज्यमनिर्दिा कस्मैचिद् विदधाम्युत॥ नाच्छिन्दे चाप्यनिादमिति जानीहि पार्थिव।
en: Thus accosted, Vaishravana said to Muchukunda and his priest,-I never, without being ordered (by the Self-born) confr sovereignty upon any one. Nor do I ever, without his behest, snatch it away from any one. Know this, O king.

sa: त्वदीयास्तांस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वतः समभिद्रुतान्। रथाश्वपत्तिद्विरदाः पाण्डवनभिदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Beholding your soldiers assailed from every side, the Kauravas, with horse, foot, elephants and cars, rushed towards the Pandavas.

sa: तस्य विस्यन्दमानेन रुधिरेणामितौजसः। प्रहारगुरुपाताच मूर्छव समजायत॥
en: A large quantity of blood being, drawn by that blow, as also owing to its violence, Bhimasena became stupefied.

sa: अवाप्यैतानि कर्माणि वेदोक्तानि धनंजय। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञो निग्रहश्चैव दुर्ग्रहः॥ दक्षिणेन च पन्थानमर्यम्णो ये दिवं गताः। एतान् क्रियावतां लोकानुक्तवान् पूर्वमप्यहम्॥
en: By performing those acts, O Dhananjaya, that are laid down in the Vedas, viz., battle, study of the Vedas, Sacrifices, the control of passion that is so difficult, one goes to heaven by the southern path of the Sun. I have, before this, told you that those very regions are reserved for persons who perform (Vedic) acts.

sa: विपर्ययेण ते भद्रे नैतदेवं भविष्यति॥ मातुस्ते ब्राह्मणो भूयात् तव च क्षत्रियः सुतः।
en: On account of the substitution of the two parts, O blessed lady, that which had been intended will not happen. Your mother will got a Brahmana child while you will get a son that will become a Kshatriya.

sa: तस्मिञ्जाते ततस्तस्मिन्सज्वालकबलाः शिवाः। क्रव्यादाश्चापसव्यानि मण्डलानि प्रचक्रमुः॥
en: On his having been born, jacka.s with flaming mouths and other ferocious beasts began to gyrate on the left.

sa: अभवच्छोणितोद्गारी वज्रदंष्ट्रः सुमूर्छितः। मुहूर्तमभवन्मूढो गदामालिङ्ग्य निःश्वसन्॥
en: Thereat vomiting blood, Vajradanstra, deprived of his senses, fro a moment overcome with stupor, stood embracing his mace, sighing.

sa: तूर्यसंघातनिर्घोषैः काञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः। मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्च प्रतिबुद्ध्यस्व शेष्व च॥
en: Do you sleep and rise up with the sound of stringed instruments, women's girdles and Nupuras and charming songs.

sa: स विजृम्भितमालोक्य हर्षाद्देवान्तको बली॥ परिघेणाभिदुद्राव मारुतात्मजमाहवे।
en: Seeing him* yawning in joy, the stalwart Devāntaka in that encounter pursued the windgod's son with his bludgeon. *Triśiras.

sa: सुग्रीवे स शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे। स्थापयामास चोद्विग्नानराक्षसान्संप्रहर्षयन्॥
en: Exciting the joy of the Răkşasas and removing their anxiety he discharged dreadful shafts at Sugrīva and his army.

sa: स बालभावाद् युधि वीर्यदर्पतः प्रवृद्धमन्युः क्षतजोपमेक्षणः। समाससादाप्रतिमं रणे कपिं गजो महाकूपमिवावृतं तृणैः॥
en: As an elephant approach a deep pit covered over with grass, (Aksa) from a spirit of childishness elated in conflict with his prowess, with his ire heightened, and eyes resembling blood, drew near the monkey in the fleld.

sa: तस्य निर्धावमानस्य संरब्धस्य युयुत्सया॥ अकस्मादैन्यमागच्छद्धयानां रथवाहिनाम्।
en: And as, burning for battle, he rushed out in wrath, the steeds drawing his car suddenly lost their energy.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः किंनराश्च महोरगाः। अन्तरिक्षगताः सर्वे द्रष्टकामास्तदद्भुतम्॥
en: To see that wondrous conflict, the celestials, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and the mighty serpents stationed themselves in the sky.

sa: तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां निःस्वनः सुमहानभूत्। वायुनोभूयमानस्य सागरस्येव निःस्वनः॥
en: They being thus driven there arose a huge noise resembling that of the ocean when agitated by the wind.

sa: अगस्त्यस्त्वब्रवीत्तत्र रामं सुप्रीतमानसम्। तांस्तान्धर्मविधींस्तत्र भ्रातरस्ते समाविशन्॥
en: Thereat there Agastya said to Rāma of a complacent mind, “The brothers severally observed the morality proper to each.”

sa: भवान्नारायणो देवश्चतुर्बाहुः सनातनः। राक्षसान्हन्तुमुत्पन्नो ह्यजय्यः प्रभुरव्ययः॥
en: And you are that eternal god the four armed Narayana, the lord, undeteriorating and unconquerable, sprung to exterminate Rāksasas.

sa: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य सुसमाहितः। मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्याञ्छरान्देहविदारणान्॥
en: And heedfully taking his bow, that first of bowmen discharged shafts resembling venomous serpents capable of piercing the body.

sa: बाणजालैः शरीरस्थैरवगाडैस्तरस्विनौ। शुशुभाते महावीर्यो प्ररूढाविव पर्वतौ॥
en: With net-works of arrows deeply entering their persons, those vehement and exceedingly powerful ones resembled mountains topped (with trees).

sa: तं चाप्रतिमकुर्वाणमचिन्त्यबलपौरुषम्। द्वारदेशमनुप्राप्तं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः॥
en: And the monkey Hanumān also beheld Rāvana, of extraordinary deeds and of inconceivable prowess and strength, at the gate.

sa: विस्फार्य च धनुर्घोरं शक्राशनिसमप्रभम्। वानराणामनीकानि प्राकिरच्छरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: And stretching his dreadful bow of the splendour of Sakra's thunder-bolt, he began to shower shafts among the monkeys-ranks.

sa: न साम्ना शक्यते कीर्तिर्न साम्ना शक्यते यशः॥ प्राप्तुं लक्ष्मण लोकेऽस्मिञ्जयो वा रणमूर्धनि।
en: By moderation one cannot attain celebrity, by moderation one cannot attain fame, and, O Lakşmaņa, in this world by moderation one cannot attain victory on the edge of battle.* *Ranamārdhani, 'The perilous edge of battle when it raged.'

sa: गवाक्षितमिवाकाशं बभूव शरवृष्टिभिः। महावेगैः सुतीक्ष्णागृध्रपत्रैः सुवाजितैः॥
en: The welkin appeared full of windows with that shower of arrows, shot with great vehemence and winged like vultures.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः। अब्रवीद्वानरान्रामः ससुग्रीवविभीषणान्॥
en: Being thus accosted by the monkeys with Vibhisana, the virtuous-souled Rama, spoke to them and Sugriva and Vibhisana, saying.

sa: पूजयंश्च पठंश्चैनमितिहासं पुरातनम्॥ सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात्।
en: By reading and worshipping this ancient history people are freed from all sins and attain to a long life.

sa: राघवं च महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम्। ददर्श मोहमापन्नं लक्ष्मणस्याङ्कमाश्रितम्॥
en: He saw that joy of the Ikşvāku race the high-souled Raghava-stupefied with grief, lying on the lap of Lakşmaņa.

sa: ज्वालामाली स तु शरः क्रव्यादानुगतो रणे। मुक्तो गुल्मान्दुमांश्चापि भस्म कृत्वा प्रधावति ॥
en: And garlanded with glory that shaft followed byghosts,* in that encounter; rushed on, burning to ashes the loose bushes and trees lying in its way. *The instrument being Siva's, it naturally was followed by ghosts as his attendants.

sa: तेन बाहुसहस्रेण संनिरुद्धजला नदी सागरोद्रागरसंकासानुद्गारान्सृजते मुहुः॥
en: Being withheld by the thousand arms of that man the waters of Narmadā were continually throwing up high waves.
